config.question: Owner: investigate executable spike entries after the last 5m candle closes; inability to pre-place a score-informed limit does not prove close entries cannot profit.
config.single_variable: Execution after the frozen touch-close score is observable: immediate market versus favorable market/rebounded retest limit versus next 5m close market.
config.confirmation_clock: Unchanged native fill-derived next H1 candle confirmation, original 1.618 reclaim/BE17 reference; delayed fill across an hour changes this clock mechanically.
config.delay_policy: At next completed 5m close, skip if target/backstop touched during the wait, a source gap occurs, week expires, or current price is outside entry bounds.
config.pending_policy: At score close, favorable/equal price enters at market; rebound rests at original 1.618, cancelled when near-edge target first hits or original week/source expiry. Independent opportunities, no invented queue or account cash reservation.
config.comparison: Conditional matched random decisions same symbol, NY week, side and causal completed14-bar TR bucket; scale original price ratios, preserve stop/target/BE rules; include rejected/unfilled opportunities at zero; cluster sign-flips by week.
config.splits: 2020-2024, 2025, 2026 retrospective segments; historical rules and 2026 already observed, not fresh out-of-sample validation.
config.buckets: Descriptive only, no threshold fitting: remaining target 0/50/100/200/500bp; chase fraction 0/.25/.5/.75/1.
config.return_basis: Native independent entry-notional bp; not portfolio returns. Old 10slot5x realized-equity/MAE-liquidation overlay quoted only as historical reference, not exchange margin or MTM account simulation.
config.limitations: Binance histories with OKX fee snapshot; no funding, depth, partial fills, measured order latency or venue parity. Exact close is an idealization; next5m is a coarse operational stress, not measured latency. Original level-anchored BE can lose money relative to a chased fill.

unchanged_level_anchored_risk.basis: Price geometry only; no actual OKX liquidation inference without margin mode, tiers, mark-price path and funding
